newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Czech Plzen buys into Lithuanian brewer.
newsitem.headline: Czech Plzen buys into Lithuanian brewer.

text.p: Czech brewer Plzensky Prazdroj has bought just over half of the share capital of the fourth largest brewer in Lithuania, Ragutis, the Baltic News Service (BNS) agency said on Monday.

Company officials were not available to confirm the report which quoted Ragutis as saying that Plzen bought 11.12 million litas of the Lithuanian company's stock out of a total 21.8 million litas share capital.
It said that Ragutis planned to start selling two new brands of beer soon and would use the Plzen funds to modernise its technology and production facilities.
